sections.title_en: A boundary version: the tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations
sections.title_zh: 边界版本：切向 Cauchy-Riemann 方程

continuations.note: The differential-form expansion of dbar w that begins on PDF 310 is completed at the top of PDF 311.
Theorem 7.1 is stated and its proof begins on PDF 320; the proof continues on PDF 321.

visual_check.note: All ten pages were rendered and visually inspected; this batch contains text, formulas and theorem/proof layouts but no new standalone teaching figures.

key_objects.name_zh: (0,1)-form 的 dbar 展开式
key_objects.name_en: dbar expansion of a (0,1)-form
key_objects.description: Completes the differential-form definition begun at the bottom of PDF 310; anti-symmetry of the wedge product gives the k<j form.
key_objects.formula: \bar∂w = Σ_{1≤k<j≤n}(∂w_j/∂\bar z_k − ∂w_k/∂\bar z_j) d\bar z_k ∧ d\bar z_j

key_objects.name_zh: dbar 方程的微分形式相容条件
key_objects.name_en: dbar consistency condition in differential-form notation
key_objects.description: The inhomogeneous system is written \bar∂u=f and its consistency condition is \bar∂f=0.

key_objects.name_zh: 切向 Cauchy-Riemann 条件的形式表达
key_objects.name_en: differential-form expression of the tangential Cauchy-Riemann condition

key_objects.name_zh: Bochner 边界延拓定理
key_objects.name_en: Bochner boundary extension theorem
key_objects.statement: Let Ω⊂C^n be bounded with C^3 boundary and connected complement. If F_0∈C^3(∂Ω) satisfies the tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations, then there is F holomorphic in Ω, continuous on the closure, with F|_{∂Ω}=F_0.

key_objects.name_zh: 修改后的边界函数满足 dbar F_1=0
key_objects.name_en: modified boundary extension with vanishing dbar

key_objects.name_zh: 非切向 Cauchy-Riemann 向量场 N
key_objects.name_en: transverse Cauchy-Riemann vector field N
key_objects.description: Used to choose a=N(F_0)/N(ρ) near the boundary so F_1=F_0-aρ satisfies (15).

key_objects.name_zh: Bochner 定理的边界修改与 dbar 修正
key_objects.name_en: boundary modification and dbar correction in Bochner theorem
key_objects.description: Set f=\bar∂F_1 in Ω, extend f by zero outside Ω, solve \bar∂u=f with compact support via Proposition 3.2, use connectedness of Ω^c to get u=0 there, and take F=F_1-u.

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 形式
key_objects.name_en: The Levi form
key_objects.description: Develops a holomorphically invariant second-order boundary form and pseudo-convexity.

key_objects.name_zh: 边界点附近的全纯规范坐标
key_objects.name_en: holomorphic canonical coordinates near a boundary point
key_objects.statement: Near z_0∈∂Ω one can introduce holomorphic coordinates centered at z_0 so that Ω is given by Im(z_n)>Σ_{j=1}^{n-1} λ_j|z_j|^2+E(z), with real λ_j and E(z)=x_nℓ(z′)+Dx_n^2+o(|z|^2).

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 规范局部边界形式
key_objects.name_en: canonical local boundary form for the Levi analysis

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 二次型的符号型是全纯不变量
key_objects.name_en: signature of the Levi quadratic form is a holomorphic invariant
key_objects.description: After diagonalizing the Hermitian form, the numbers of positive, negative, and zero λ_j are invariant under holomorphic coordinate changes.

key_objects.name_zh: 边界函数的二阶对角化
key_objects.name_en: diagonalized second-order boundary function

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 形式
key_objects.name_en: Levi form
key_objects.description: The Hermitian form given in canonical coordinates by Σ λ_j|z_j|^2, or intrinsically by the complex Hessian of a defining function restricted to the complex tangent space.

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 形式的内在表达
key_objects.name_en: intrinsic expression of the Levi form
key_objects.formula: Σ_{1≤j,k≤n} (∂²ρ/∂z_j∂\bar z_k) a_j\overline{a_k}, restricted to complex tangent vectors

key_objects.name_zh: 伪凸边界点
key_objects.name_en: pseudo-convex boundary point
key_objects.description: A boundary point is pseudo-convex when the Levi form is non-negative there.

key_objects.name_zh: 强伪凸边界点
key_objects.name_en: strongly pseudo-convex boundary point
key_objects.description: A boundary point is strongly pseudo-convex when the Levi form is strictly positive definite.

key_objects.name_zh: 单位球是强伪凸的
key_objects.name_en: the unit ball is strongly pseudo-convex
key_objects.description: For ρ(z)=|z|²−1 the Levi form is the identity on the complex tangent space at every boundary point.

key_objects.name_zh: 极大值原理
key_objects.name_en: A maximum principle
key_objects.description: A local maximum principle follows when the Levi form has at least one strictly positive eigenvalue.

key_objects.name_zh: Levi 正特征值下的局部极大值原理
key_objects.name_en: local maximum principle under a positive Levi eigenvalue
key_objects.statement: If Ω has C² boundary and at each point of ∂Ω∩B the Levi form has at least one strictly positive eigenvalue, then a smaller ball B′ exists so every F holomorphic on Ω∩B and continuous up to the relevant boundary satisfies the estimate (19).

key_objects.name_zh: 局部极大值估计
key_objects.name_en: local maximum-principle estimate

key_objects.name_zh: 一维切片的预备估计
key_objects.name_en: preliminary one-dimensional slice estimate

key_objects.name_zh: 切片边界落在区域边界上的关键事实
key_objects.name_en: key fact for the slice boundary

key_objects.name_zh: 最近边界点投影 π(z)
key_objects.name_en: nearest-boundary projection pi(z)
key_objects.description: For interior points sufficiently close to ∂Ω there is a unique nearest point π(z)∈∂Ω, and the segment from π(z) to z is perpendicular to the tangent plane; this reduces the general estimate to the canonical one-slice setting.

key_objects.name_zh: 局部超曲面版本的极大值原理
key_objects.name_en: local-hypersurface version of the maximum principle
key_objects.statement: If a local C² hypersurface M has at least one strictly positive Levi eigenvalue at every point, then near each z_0∈M, holomorphic F on the negative side Ω^- satisfies estimate (22).

key_objects.name_zh: 局部超曲面极大值估计
key_objects.name_en: local-hypersurface maximum estimate

key_objects.name_zh: 逼近与延拓定理
key_objects.name_en: Approximation and extension theorems
key_objects.description: Introduces the Baouendi-Treves local polynomial approximation theorem for weak CR functions on a hypersurface.

key_objects.name_zh: 局部超曲面图表示
key_objects.name_en: local graph representation of the hypersurface

key_objects.name_zh: 切向 Cauchy-Riemann 算子 L_j
key_objects.name_en: tangential Cauchy-Riemann operator L_j

key_objects.name_zh: L_j 的转置与弱切向 Cauchy-Riemann 方程
key_objects.name_en: transpose of L_j and weak tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations
key_objects.description: Define L_j^t by integration by parts; a continuous f satisfies the tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations weakly when ∫ f L_j^t(ψ)=0 for all sufficiently small compactly supported C¹ test functions ψ.

key_objects.name_zh: Baouendi-Treves 逼近定理
key_objects.name_en: Baouendi-Treves approximation theorem
key_objects.statement: For a C² hypersurface M and z_0∈M, there are balls B′⊂B centered at z_0 such that every continuous F on M∩B satisfying the tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations weakly can be uniformly approximated on M∩B′ by holomorphic polynomials in z_1,...,z_n.

key_objects.name_zh: 超曲面由切片 M_u 纤维化
key_objects.name_en: fibration of the hypersurface by slices M_u
key_objects.description: Fix u∈R^{n−1} and define M_u by z′=x′+iu with y_n=φ(z′,x_n); the hypersurface is fibred by the collection {M_u}.

key_objects.name_zh: 切片参数化 Φ_u 与复 Jacobian
key_objects.name_en: slice parametrization Phi_u and its complex Jacobian
key_objects.description: The map Φ_u(x)=(x′+iu, x_n+iφ(x′+iu,x_n)) identifies a neighborhood in R^n with M_u. Its derivative is I+A(x), det(∂Φ/∂x)=1+iφ_{x_n}, and the induced measure is dm_u=J(x)dx. The proof continues next batch.
